title: Extraction of a finite trivializing datum
statement: For a field $k$, finite commutative ring $\\Lambda$ and constructible sheaf $G$ as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], there exists a $LocallyConstantDatum\\ d$ for $G$ such that every member of its finite etale cover restricts $G$ to a constant sheaf with a finite $\\Lambda$-module value.

proof.text: Unpack the constructibility witness: on the one-point spectrum of a field, retain the nonempty stratum and its locally constant datum, whose cover members carry finite constant values.

mathlib_searches.query: finite trivializing datum constructible sheaf field

lean.statement:
theorem constructible_field_finite_separable_constant_datum
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (G : Sheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hG : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G) :
    ∃ d : LocallyConstantDatum G, ∀ i : d.cover.I₀,
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
        Nonempty ((G.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅
          (constantSheaf
            ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).smallEtaleTopology.over
              (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
